summary: Backend-only testing completed for Music League app. All 14 tests passed covering: Auth (register/login), League (create/join), Round (create/advance), Voting (N-1 point system, non-voter auto-distribution, ties), Standings accumulation, and User stats.
critical_code_review_comments: N-1 voting point system correctly implemented: 1st place gets (N-1) pts, 2nd gets (N-2), etc. where N = number of submitters
Non-voter auto-distribution working correctly: evenly distributes missing voter's points to all other songs
Tie handling verified: users with same points get same rank, is_tie flag set correctly, multiple winners listed
Standings accumulation across rounds working correctly with proper N-1 logic
Non-submitters correctly receive 0 points and 0 rounds_played in standings
seed_data_creation: Test users created with TEST_ prefix for each test class
